episode_diversity._comment: Fallback for Lewis & Clark packs only when pack.json omits episode_diversity; non-LC packs ignore this.

fal_broll_scene_anchor._comment: When false (default), B-roll Wan uses scene anchors only for segments with a portrait-backed reference_character_id (lewis, clark, drouillard, york, composites, etc.). Segments without a clear character use text-to-video. Set enabled true to allow anchors on all B-roll segments.

visual_themes.name: Grounded Historical Realism
visual_themes.description: Grounded documentary realism: naturalistic soft-daylight key, muted true earth tones, medium contrast, 35mm-equivalent moderate depth of field; believable physics in cloth, water, smoke, and human motion—nothing stylized or fantastical.

visual_themes.name: Observational Nature Study
visual_themes.description: Natural-history look: cool daylight white balance, low-to-medium contrast, wide-to-normal lens with deep focus; lingering shots of terrain, rivers, plants, animals, and weather, as if quietly recorded in the field.

visual_themes.name: Slow Cinema Minimalism
visual_themes.description: Slow cinema minimalism: low-contrast desaturated grade, soft overcast or twilight key, long quiet shadows, shallow depth of field on a longer lens; very little motion, long-held shots, tiny shifts in light or water carrying the moment.

video_prompt_replacements.find: the Newfoundland dog, the Newfoundland dog

archived_visual_themes.name: Material Culture Focus on human artifacts
archived_visual_themes.description: Material-culture close study: warm firelight/window key, rich contrast holding texture in leather, wood grain, and metal, shallow depth of field on a longer lens; everyday tools, packs, weapons, cookware, and camp goods in extreme texture detail.

archived_visual_themes.name: Exploratory futuristic science adventure
archived_visual_themes.description: Exploratory pacing and sense of journey; clean compositions and deliberate camera motion; crisp, almost documentary-futurist clarity applied to historical subjects.

archived_visual_themes.name: Hand-drawn historical illustration
archived_visual_themes.description: Live-action expedition footage with an ink-and-wash mood—muted sepia, soft washes, delicate light—no drawn lines, paper edges, engraving texture, or anything that reads as text or a document; stay photoreal, not a picture of a page.

archived_visual_themes.name: Educational schematic visualization
archived_visual_themes.description: Minimalist diagram-like framing and cutaway-style views that emphasize structure and function; suggest diagrams through composition and simplified forms, not legible labels or typography.

archived_visual_themes.name: Period Engraving / Etching
archived_visual_themes.description: High-contrast engraved look inspired by early 19th-century prints.

archived_visual_themes.name: Painterly Landscape Study
archived_visual_themes.description: Outdoor landforms, riverscapes, and sky; soft brushstroke-like treatment, atmospheric perspective, emphasis on light, distance, and scale.

archived_visual_themes.name: Minimalist Schematic Visualization
archived_visual_themes.description: Clean shapes, restrained color, simplified forms that read almost schematic; imply structure through layout and negative space, not charts or readable text.

archived_visual_themes.name: Measured World
archived_visual_themes.description: Surveying and geometry suggested through composition, sightlines, and spatial rhythm; imply distance, angle, bearing, and elevation without legible numbers, scales, or labels.

archived_visual_themes.name: Monochrome Field Notes
archived_visual_themes.description: Limited, near-monochrome palette; tight, notebook-like framing; the feel of quick field observation without legible handwriting or labels.

archived_visual_themes.name: Silhouette and Shadow
archived_visual_themes.description: Strong light–dark contrast; backlit silhouettes and deep shadow; human forms and gear suggested by outline rather than fine facial or fabric detail.

archived_visual_themes.name: Abstract atmospheric impression
archived_visual_themes.description: Emphasize wind, water, light, and mood over literal detail; stay photoreal, not illustrated. No legible text, captions, or diagram overlays in the scene.

archived_visual_themes.name: Charcoal Field Sketches
archived_visual_themes.description: Soft charcoal and graphite linework with subtle paper texture; loose shading and smudges that feel like field sketches made on the spot.

archived_visual_themes.name: Woodcut Chronicle
archived_visual_themes.description: Bold, blocky shapes and heavy black contours like hand-carved woodcut prints; simplified forms with strong light and dark contrast.

archived_visual_themes.name: River Mirror Reflections
archived_visual_themes.description: Compositions built around reflections in water—boats, trees, and sky—using calm surfaces and soft ripples to double the scene and emphasize symmetry.

archived_visual_themes.name: Campfire Recollection
archived_visual_themes.description: Memory of firelight: soft vignette, warm cast, gentle blur—one continuous shot or at most two figures; no split screen or panels.

archived_visual_themes.name: Sky-Dominant Horizons
archived_visual_themes.description: Low camera and wide framing that give most of the frame to the sky; cloud formations, light gradients, and changing weather dominate over land and river detail.
